title: 3 Ensuites! King Bed + Walk to Coffee + Brewery!
description:
Luxury meets convenience in the heart of East Nashville. Whether you’re here for a songwriter’s retreat, a family getaway, or a Broadway blitz, this professionally designed 3-story home offers the perfect balance of privacy and social space. Why Guests Love It:

Privacy for Everyone: 3 bedrooms, each with its own private ensuite bathroom.

Work-Ready: Blazing-fast Fiber Internet for remote work or streaming.

Prime Location: Walk to Elegy Coffee & Living Waters Brewery; 10 mins to Broadway.

The space
Welcome to your elegant three-story retreat in East Nashville, where comfort, style, and convenience come together to offer an unmatched Airbnb experience. Located within walking distance of local breweries, delicious restaurants, and cozy coffee shops, this 3 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom townhome is a dream for couples and groups. 

Step inside to discover the thoughtfully designed interior, filled with natural light and contemporary charm. Each floor of this townhome offers something special, all linked by a blazing-fast fiber internet connection.

On the first floor, you'll find a secluded and relaxing space featuring a queen bed with a pull-out trundle twin bed, complemented by a private ensuite bathroom and a private patio. This space is perfect for guests seeking a touch of privacy.

The second floor serves as the social hub of the home. With a fully-stocked kitchen equipped with all you'll need for in-home dining, to a comfortably furnished living room with a large 55" TV - it's the perfect place to unwind after a day exploring Music City.  Think movie night or game day! 

Ascend to the third floor, where a sanctuary with two Primary suites await. The first suite boasts a luxurious king bed and an ensuite bath, while the second offers a comfy queen bed with its own private bath. Also located on this floor is a convenient laundry room with a washer and dryer, complete with complimentary detergent.

Traveling with a bigger group? We manage the home right next door! Message us and we can help you book these homes together. 

Don't forget about the remarkable amenities this property offers:
» Ultra-fast and reliable wifi
» Complimentary coffee to start your day right
» Free covered parking for one vehicle, providing easy access to the property
» Smart TVs - sign into your own streaming apps
» Complimentary shampoo, body wash, and a hairdryer
» Iron and ironing board for your convenience

Our East Nashville property, managed by a professional local superhost, is a top-rated choice among travelers with over 3200 five-star reviews. 

Experience the blend of Nashville charm and upscale comfort. Book your stay now and make this townhome your base for your Music City adventures.

Guest access
Get ready to make yourself at home! You'll have full reign of the entire home, including the spacious the covered parking area for 1 vehicle.  Just a little heads up, there's a management supply closet that remains locked off the kitchen. That's our behind-the-scenes magic cupboard where we stash all we need for sprucing up the place for our lovely guests. So, that's off-limits. Other than that, every corner of this house is yours to explore and enjoy!

Other things to note
Neighborhood Respect: Our home is nestled among friendly neighbors. We kindly ask you to respect the local community by observing outdoor quiet hours between 9 PM and 6 AM. Help us keep East Nashville wonderful by respecting our friendly neighbors.

Flexible Check-In/Out: Need an early check-in or late check-out? Let us know a day or two before your arrival/departure. We'll try our best to accommodate your request, when available, a $25/hour fee applies.

Security for Peace of Mind: Your safety is important. While our exterior security cameras and interior noise monitors are not actively monitored for guest safety, they help us maintain a secure and respectful environment in line with our rental policies.

Party and Event Policy: To ensure everyone's enjoyment, please note that parties and events are strictly prohibited, though we welcome Bachelorette and Bachelor groups. Any tampering with security equipment may affect your security deposit.

Local Guest Policy: To maintain the quality and security of our properties, we have a special policy for local guests residing within 60 miles of Nashville. If you're a local, please send us an inquiry or a request to book for pre-approval before making your reservation. This helps us ensure a great fit for both our guests and our properties. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to possibly hosting you!

Seamless Check-In: To ensure a fantastic experience for both you and us, we ask our guests to digitally sign a brief rental agreement after booking confirmation. This agreement simply verifies your identity and outlines our straightforward policies on check-in/out, noise, and more, ensuring your stay is enjoyable and hassle-free. We provide self check-in to ensure traveler flexibility.  We appreciate your cooperation and can't wait to host you!

Ready to Host You: We're excited to welcome travelers from around the world. Message us to start planning your perfect Nashville adventure!
